Commentary.Commentary: The Proteas have taken a very significant 81-run lead. Philander struck twice in the first over of the day to set the tone and although the last wicket added a few runs, they couldn't cut down the deficit by much. The Lankans would be disappointed with the batting effort. Their lower middle order saved them the blushes as otherwise, South Africa would have gotten a bigger lead. Philander was the star for the hosts with a 5-fer. The Protea innings isn't far away.

OUT! ABBOTT WRAPS IT UP! Good length in the corridor of uncertainty, a hint of away movement and induces the edge once more. This time, it carries easily to first slip where Amla gobbles up the offering. Ideal morning for the Proteas. SRI LANKA HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 205.
Length ball outside off, Chameera pokes again and this time gets an edge but doesn't carry to gully where it is well stopped by Duminy.
Length ball outside off, Chameera pushes at it but is beaten.
Full ball outside off, Pradeep drives it sweetly past the covers. Well timed and three more runs to the total.
Fuller outside off, pushed gently to the covers.
Once more! Good length outside off, Chameera pushes at it but is beaten.
Length ball outside off, Chameera's turn to get beaten.
Short ball from Philander and Chameera ducks under it.
Length ball outside off, Chameera is beaten on the poke.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Fuller on middle, Chameera uses his long handle to perfection as he lofts it over mid on for a boundary. Handy runs these for the Lankans.
Length ball closer to off, blocked well from the crease.
Back of a length outside off, Pradeep is beaten once more.
Full outside off, leans into it and defends it well.
FOUR! Streaky runs!  Back of a length outside off, Nuwan pokes at it but gets a thick edge that flies it to the third man fence for a boundary.
Good length outside off, Pradeep pushes tamely at it and is beaten.
Back of a length outside off, defended well off the back foot.
Good length outside off, leans forward and blocks it well.
Length ball around off, defended well from the crease.

Weird incident. Full on off, Chameera drives it past the bowler. The ball deflects off Pradeep onto the stumps at the non-striker's end. Abbot who was the closest to the incident starts appealing as Pradeep was out of his crease. However, the ball hadn't touched any Protea player on its way and it is ruled as not out.
This is a freakish incident.
Length ball outside off, late away movement to beat the outside edge.
Good length outside off, blocked well from the crease.
Length ball outside off, another play and a miss from Chameera.
Another run out chance missed. This was tapped to cover where Bavuma was quick to swoop in on the ball but he misses the throw at the bowler's end. Pradeep was well short if that had hit.
Dug in short on middle, Chameera ducks instantly under it.
Good length angled in from around off, Chameera fails to push at it but is struck high on the pads.
Back of a length outside off, Chameera tries the slash but connects thin air.
Pitched up outside off, well blocked off the front foot.
Fuller down the leg side, Chameera shuffles to whip it away but misses.
Banged in short by Abbott, comfortably left alone to the keeper.
Fullish on middle, pushes gently towards short mid-wicket for a single. Abbott is too slow to get to the ball.
Sprays this down the leg side, Chameera fails to connect the flick.
Full on middle, gets across and blocks it well.
Fuller this time just outside off, keeps a bit low as well as the ball whizzes past the outside edge.
Beaten again! Good length outside off, Chameera flirts with it but fails to make contact.
Length ball slanting in from around off, tapped gently towards point.
Good length outside off, Pradeep pokes at it but is beaten.

Run out chance missed! Fullish around off, tapped towards the covers for a quick single. Shy at the bowler's end misses , Chameera was a goner had that hit. The man backing up cannot reach it and the ball races away to the fence for a boundary. Five runs added to the total!
Short ball on middle, Chameera ducks under the bumper.
And again! Length ball closer to off, Chameera pushes at it but is beaten comprehensively.
Good length outside off, shapes away a bit to whiz past the outside edge.
Length ball outside off, Chameera pushes at it but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man for a brace.
KYLE ABBOTT from the other end.
NUWAN PRADEEP is the last man in.

OUT! GONE! Double whammy for Philander to start the day! Fuller on off, a bit of inswing as Lakmal overbalances on the drive. Spoons a simple catch to mid on where Abbott takes the catch with ease. Dream start for the Proteas this morning. Down to the last wicket now. 11th Test fifer for Philander. His purple patch continues.
Lakmal is caught at mid on. They are checking for the no ball. Philander seems to be okay.
Almost a replica of the previous ball. The outswinger outside off, Lakmal looks to poke at it but is beaten again.
Beaten! Full and outside off, shapes away extravagantly to go well past the outside edge.
FOUR! FAB SHOT! Back of a length outside off, Lakmal hangs back and punches it sweetly through the covers. That's a shot that would make a top order batsman proud. Handy runs these for the Lankans.
Good length around off, blocked solidly off the back foot.
SURANGA LAKMAL is the new man in.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Perfect start to the day for South Africa. Good length closer to off, a hint of shape away and de Silva is forced to play at it. Gets squared up a bit and the nick is comfortably pouched by de Kock. Ends a fine knock from Dhananjaya but he would be gutted at getting out so early in the day. SL TRAIL BY 105.
The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. Vital first session this in the context of the game. De Silva is on strike, VERNON PHILANDER to start proceedings on day 3.

Sri Lanka trail by 105 runs with 3 wickets in their hands. They would look to get as close as possible to RSA's total. The hosts on the other hand would look to clean up the tail quickly and get a decent first innings' lead. We are in for another enticing day of contest between bat and ball. Stay tuned for all the action on day 3!

Hello and warm welcome to the 3rd day of the Boxing Day Test between South Africa and Sri Lanka. Lakmal's fifer helped the visitors bowl out the hosts for a mere 286 after a good start by the South African openers. However, the home side came back strongly with their quickies ripping through the Lankan batting lineup and reducing them to 181/7 at the end of the day.
... DAY 3, SESSION 1 ...

Tomorrow, the Lankans will set out to achieve what the Proteas could not this morning. Another 50 runs would be really handy but having said that, the home side will aim to get the remaining 3 wickets quickly, before the total crosses 200. De Silva might want to play some counter-attacking strokes. Do join us tomorrow for a likely early start. You can however, tune in much earlier and have a look at the second Australia-Pakistan Test at the MCG as well. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

The plan must have been from the Lankans to tire out the South African speedsters but they were reduced to 22/3 in no time. The middle order rallied around a touch but runs were not coming. Then, Rangana Herath came in and played some strokes which lifted the Lankan spirits. Philander has three wickets while Abbott got 2. Rabada was disappointing.

Sri Lanka probably surprised themselves as well by bowling out the Proteas so quickly this morning. Everyone expected the home side to get some quick runs, reach somewhere around 325-350 but they faced just 8.5 overs and made a mere 19 runs, not even reaching 300. Lakmal got a well-deserved five-wicket haul and the Lankans were cock-a-hoop on getting the hosts all out for an average score by their standards.

2030 IST - Bad news, folks. Unfortunately, light has not improved for the players to come back on and that will be STUMPS ON DAY 2. An attritional day of cricket, with only 200 runs being scored in 65.5 overs. That period after Tea quickened things a touch but overall, the scoring was pretty slow.

South Africa tried hard and did well with the ball reversing. Kyle Abbott and Vernon Philander exploited the conditions nicely but Rabada was still disappointing. Keshav Maharaj got the wicket of Herath who was causing problems to the Proteas. It has gone brighter a touch but one side of the ground is still very dark. Fingers crossed. Stay tuned for updates.

A good period of play for the Lankans. They lost Chandimal quickly after Tea but the quickfire 36-run stand between Herath and de Silva has given them some momentum. de Silva has looked good for his 43 and Chameera has given him good company in a stand worth 24.

2000 IST - It was bright and sunny during the Drinks break but all of a sudden, a massive group of dark clouds has enveloped the ground. The umpires have got together for a chat and have decided that the PLAYERS CAN WALK OFF. Guess du Plessis might have been given the option of employing spinners from both ends but understandably he might not have wanted it. Duminy has an argument with umpire Oxenford and seems unhappy that the players are being taken off.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Nice shot. Comes down the track and whips it with full control of the wrists over mid-wicket for a boundary!
WHY DID HE NOT GO FOR THE CATCH? A short ball down the leg side, de Silva pulls it towards fine leg. Strangely, Keshav Maharaj at fine leg does not charge in and the ball lands in front of him.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
FOUR! Full and outside off, de Silva opens the face of the bat and pushes it past second slip to the third man fence.
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
KAGISO RABADA is back on.
A touch short and outside off, de Silva punches it back uppishly but wide of the diving bowler to his right. Nearly collides with the non-striker. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Flighted full ball on off, Dhananjaya gets on the front foot and defends it with the spin to the off side.
Quicker and fuller on the pads, helped through mid-wicket for one.
Advances down the track and nudges it through mid on for a single.
Tossed up again but down the leg side, Dhananjaya eases it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Fuller and around off, it's defended off the front foot by de Silva.
DRINKS BREAK. The clouds have cleared up and now the sun is shining brightly in the middle.
A bouncer to end the over, DC ducks.
Full on middle and off, wristily pushed to mid on.
A bouncer on middle and leg, Chameera ducks.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Very full around off, almost a yorker, squeezed towards short mid-wicket.

Strange. Full and on leg stump, Dushmantha looks to defend but the ball goes off the inside edge past short leg towards short fine leg. De Silva takes the single. But why now? Exposing Chameera to Abbott?
Full and down the leg side, Chameera looks to flick but misses. He is hit on the pads and an LBW appeal ensues but that pitched outside leg.
Pushes this through mid on for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
DROPPED? Yes. Full and outside off, de Silva comes down the track and smashes it straight back to the bowler. Maharaj is unable to take it to his left.
Full and around off, defended to the off side.
The batsman does well to leave that bouncer.
The ball takes the outside edge goes towards the slip region.
FOUR! A short ball down the leg side, Chameera looks to pull but is cramped for room. The ball goes off his gloves to the fine leg fence.
A short ball, pulled away. This time he takes the single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and around off, nipping in, de Silva pushes it towards long on. Does not take the single.
Stays back in his crease and blocks.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Around middle and leg, well kept out.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
DUSHMANTHA CHAMEERA walks in at number 9, replacing Herath.

OUT! LBW! Maharaj has struck. Full and outside off, Herath looks to play the reverse sweep but misses. He is hit in line of the stumps and umpire Aleem Dar raises his finger on the appeal. Hawk Eye shows the impact to be umpire's call. The 36-run stand in 52 balls has been broken. Useful innings from Herath. Got the scoreboard moving. SRI LANKA TRAIL BY 129 NOW.
A short ball around middle, Rangana takes his eyes off the ball and plays a pull shot. It goes in the air but the square leg region is unmanned. A run taken. The deficit is now 129.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and just outside off, watchfully pushed back.
Full and outside off, nice line and length, de Silva shoulders arms.
Outside off, pushed behind point for a couple.
KYLE ABBOTT returns.
The floodlights have been switched on.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Slightly short around off, Herath thinks about sweeping, then tries pulling, ends up dragging it to mid-wicket.
Action replay of the previous ball.
Full and outside off, this time RH defends in a composed manner.
Huge appeal for LBW. Impact probably outside off. Full and outside off, Rangana attempts the conventional sweep now but misses and is hit on the pads. Hawk Eye confirms the impact to be outside off.
Full and outside off, sping in, Herath looks to play the reverse sweep but gets a bottom edge on the bounce to Hashim Amla at first slip.
Played to the point region by the batsman.

Just over! A short ball around middle, Rangana looks to pull but miscues it just over a leaping mid on. The ball is stopped near the ropes and three runs are taken. 150 UP FOR SRI LANKA! The stand is worth 32 from 38 balls.
Landed outside off, left alone. NO BALL signalled as Rabada overstepped. Replays do not support it though. That foot seemed to graze the line.
Landed around off, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
A short ball around middle, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
A bouncer on middle and leg, Rangana ducks.
The leg gully goes even finer, towards leg slip.

FOUR! The plan almost works! Faf has kept a leg gully in place and Herath gets this outside leg. But he tickles this very fine, in a controlled manner, fine of the leg gully to the fine leg fence. The deficit is now 139.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Outside off, played straight to point.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Nice shot. Comes down the track and lofts it with ease over mid on for a boundary.
Full again, Herath gives it the full-blooded sweep and gets it to backward square leg for a single.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short leg.
The umpires check for the light. Seems to be fine for now. Faf du Plessis realizes that he has to bring on a spinner. KESHAV MAHARAJ comes on to bowl.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Down the leg side again, tickled past the keeper for another boundary.
FOUR! Overcompensation to the previous ball. Full and down the leg side, tickled past the keeper to the fine leg fence.
Outside off, Herath pushes but misses.
Short and down the leg side, Herath misses his tuck.
On a good length outside off, Rangana stays back and defends it towards cover.
KAGISO RABADA is back on. The clouds are coming on at a fast pace. Not raining yet.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman has lofted that over mid wicket. They manage to come back for the second.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
On middle and leg, tucked straight to short mid-wicket.

Landed outside off, pretty wide, Dhananjaya thinks there are runs on offer and goes after the width. But his feet do not support the movement of his hands and he ends up reaching out for it, being far from the ball. A play and a miss in the end.
Full and straight, de Silva defends it back to the bowler.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Down the leg side, Herath misses his flick and the ball goes off his thigh pads behind. De Kock flies to his right to stop it with his right glove.
Uh oh.... the rain clouds are coming... it has gone overcast in the last 15 minutes.
On a good length around middle and off, tucked through mid-wicket for a single. The deficit is now 159.
Full and outside off, swinging away, shouldered arms to.
On a good length outside off, defended solidly.
Landed outside off, left alone.

Close call! That looked very close. Full on middle and leg, swinging in, Rangana missed his flick and was hit on the pads. Abbott appealed for LBW but Aleem Dar shook his head. Was there an inside edge? That could have been the only thing.

Well... spot the ball! For a second, we thought that all of us had gone blind. Because Abbott seemed to deliver the ball but we did not know where the ball went. Then Philander was shown at mid-wicket, picking up the ball. Replays show that while trying to deliver, Abbott lost control of the cherry and it slipped out of his hand.
Beaten for pace. Full and wide outside off, Herath has a nervous slash and  misses.
Full on middle and leg, RH just about gets his bat down in time to defend. Gets an inside edge.

ALMOST SELLS HIS PARTNER DOWN THE RIVER. Herath works this through square leg and calls his partner for the single. De Silva comes down a long way but then Herath changes his mind. De Silva has to turn back and the fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Stephen Cook comes in from mid off and has an underarm shy at the stumps but misses too. De Silva could have been dismissed both times.
Ooohh.... Abbott lands this on a good length outside off, Rangana gets across and lets it go. The ball nips back in and just misses the off stump. Abbott wipes off the sweat from his brow.
A short ball around leg, Herath gets out of the way. Abbott scratches his nose and gives a stare to Herath who does not want to return the favour.
Gets across and tucks it to fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Nice shot! Fractionally short around middle, Herath helps it over square leg via a pull and gets a boundary! He did very well against Australia at home, of course with the ball for sure but with the bat too.
Outside off, nice bounce, pushed to the man at cover.
RANGANA HERATH walks in at number 8, replacing Chandimal.

OUT! LBW! Philander gets the breakthrough. It is his third wicket. A lovely delivery from the big Vern. Lands it on a good length outside off, makes it to jag back in and gets past the bat of Chandimal as he looks to defend, hitting him on the back pad. Umpire Oxenford does not take too much time to raise his finger and Chandimal takes the review. It seems more because of the fact that this is the last recognized batting pair. Unfortunately for him, it is three reds on the review. Pitched outside off, impact in line and going on to hit a good part of the middle stump. Chandimal walks back for 28. Another batsman dismissed after a start. SRI LANKA STILL TRAIL BY 165 RUNS.
Chandimal has been adjudged LBW! He has taken the review though. Looks more out of hope.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Short and down the leg side, de Silva looks to tuck it away but the ball goes off his hips towards square leg. A leg bye taken.
That is a peach. On a good length outside off, Dinesh gets across to defend but then the ball moves away and squares him up. Beats the outside edge.

Huge LBW appeal. Turned down. Abbott is frustrated. He believes he had his man. Is it? Let us see in the replays. On a good length outside off, coming in a long way, beating Chandimal on the forward defense and hitting him on the pads. That looked to be going down leg. Abbott kept on appealing and even extended it. Aleem Dar was as cool as a cucumber.
Outside off, left alone.
Full and outside off, again Dinesh  looks to put bat to it and pushes it to mid off.
Play and a miss. Full and wide outside off, could have been left alone, but Chandimal lunges to push and misses. Abbott is setting Chandimal up for the balls coming in.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
The fourth umpire was out during the change in overs. He replaced one of the stumps.
On a good length outside off, DdS gets across and defends it watchfully.
Ahhh... Philander lands it in the corridor of uncertainty, gets Dhananjaya prodding at it but generates enough movement to beat the outside edge.

FOUR! Uppish, but safe. Full on middle and leg, de Silva just flicks it without moving his feet. Good use of his wrists but no movement of his feet. The ball just goes over short mid-wicket and meets the fence. The deficit is now 166.
Landed outside off, allowed to go through.

This one moves away from the batsman and de Silva pushes it through the covers. There is some urgency in running and the batsmen return for the second. A better throw to the bowler could have had Chandimal in trouble. De Silva moves to 11.
On a good length around off, de Silva rises with the bounce and defends.
VERNON PHILANDER to continue after Tea.

FOUR! Nicely done. Full and outside off, Chandimal comes forward, opens the face of the bat and gently runs it down through the vacant gully region to third man. 10 runs from the over and the stand is worth 20 now.

That is a nice-looking shot. Full and outside off, de Silva comes forward and strokes it wide of mid off. Stephen Cook gives it a good chase from mid off, gets to the ball and slides to haul it back in. Three runs taken.

Angles this prodigiously into the right-hander, but the length is a bit too short to make the batsman uncomfortable. Chandimal works it behind square leg for a single. The South Africans might be looking to exploit reverse swing, if available. They did that recently in Perth against Australia and reaped rich rewards. The deficit is now 179.
Landed outside off, left alone.
Outside off, nicely punched through the covers for a couple.
On a good length just around off, angling in, defended solidly.

Welcome back for the final session. the players would have been rejuvenated a bit and it is necessary, as this could end being a 150-minute session. 41 overs to be bowled. KYLE ABBOTT to begin proceedings to Chandimal.
... DAY 2, SESSION 3 ...

All the bowlers have been decent for South Africa, with the exception of Rabada. They have used only 4 bowlers so far but should the wickets not fall soon, the Proteas would be forced to use the services of Duminy or Elgar which should be a moral victory for the visitors. 41 overs are left in the day, which is a long time to play. The hosts will be looking to break this stand and then run through the lower order. Join us back at 1830 IST (1300 GMT) for the final session.

Chandimal and Dhananjaya de Silva seem to be positive in approach but both are flashy as well. The former got a chance on 17 when de Kock could not take a diving catch off Rabada. The wicket-keeper batsman will look to make the Proteas pay.

Sri Lanka started the session well, with Mathews and Kaushal Silva seeing off the fast bowlers. However, both could not convert their starts and departed without scoring much. As Ian Chappell of Australia and Geoffrey Boycott of England always say on commentary - It is always nice to tire the bowlers but you need to score runs as well. Because if you don't then even if you play for two hours but lose two wickets after those couple of hours, you would not have gained much. That is exactly what has happened here. South Africa have dried the runs and Sri Lanka have just not been able to counter-attack or make a bold move.

SESSION 5 - 67/2 in 25 overs. An attritional session. South Africa have not given much away while Sri Lanka have been firm as well. The ball has gone softer and as a result, the swing and movement have lessened considerably.
Another play and a miss to end the session. Full and outside off, de Silva flashes a drive but misses. TEA ON DAY 2, SRI LANKA TRAIL BY 182!
Play and a miss. On a good length outside off, DdS goes after it half-heartedly, a lazy poke, and misses the ball by a good margin.
On off and outside, Dhananjaya gets across a touch and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, swinging away, de Silva drives it towards mid off. The ball has gone softer, so perhaps the timing was not that great.
Action replay of the previous delivery. It is almost like a tape is being shown again and again.
Short mid-wicket has moved to second slip for Philander.
Full and just around off, defended with a dead bat.
Full and straight, pushed back to the bowler.
Change of field. Short leg goes across to silly point.
Full and outside off, pushed towards extra cover.
A little bit of loop on this one, Chandimal pushes it towards long off but Maharaj gets across to his left to stop the ball.
Full and around middle and off, watchfully defended.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman has edged that one. They pick up a single.
Oohhh.... this one nips back in a long way, Dinesh falls over in his attempt to flick and is hit on the pads. Philander appeals but the umpire shakes his head. No reviews left. Maybe going down leg.
Similar ball to the previous one, this time Chandimal decides to play at it. Comes forward and drives it to short cover.
Goes a touch wider than the previous one, DC lunges forward and then shoulders arms.
Consistency from Philander, keeps it just around off or outside, Dinesh defends again.
Very full and straight, Chandimal manages to get his bat down in time to block.
Full and outside off, left alone.
VERNON PHILANDER comes back on with 10 minutes to go to Tea.
Back to a fuller length outside off, Dhananjaya defends by coming forward.

FOUR! Short and outside off, de Silva is quick to pounce on it. Goes back and punches it through the covers for a boundary to raise the SRI LANKAN 100. Given the accuracy with which the Proteas are bowling, it is important for Sri Lanka to put away the bad balls.
Full and straight, another forward defense.
This is around off, de Silva comes forward and blocks.
On the pads, flicked straight to short leg.
Full and around off, watchfully defended in front of silly point.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Full and miles outside off, almost outside the pitch, left alone. Rabada is lucky that it is not wided.
Down the leg side, Dinesh misses his flick. De Kock flies to his left to stop that.

FOUR! Honesty to the core from Abbott. Fullish on middle, Chandimal flicks it through square leg. Kyle Abbott covers good ground to his left from fine leg, gets to the ball with a slide, stops it and returns the same. But while getting up, his foot perhaps touches the ropes. He communicates the same to the umpire who checks and replays confirm the same. A boundary then.
This is interesting. Honest from Kyle Abbott. He has done a fielding effort but wants the umpire to check whether it was clean. Referred upstairs...

EDGED, DROPPED! Tough luck for Rabada. He has not been bowling that well today but has managed to get Mathews. Could have had Chandimal as well. Full and outside off, Chandimal pokes at it and the away movement generates an outside edge. de Kock flies to his right, goes at it with one glove, but is unable to hold on. Mind you, he does not drop many.
On a length around middle, tucked towards fine leg for a single.
Flighted and on middle, Chandimal defends it off his front foot to the off side.
Slower through the air, full and on off, DC is on the front foot in defense.
Floated one on off, giving some air, Chandimal hits it through the line but finds the cover fielder.

NOT OUT! Tossed up ball on off, spinning away a shade, Chandimal gets forward with a big stretch to defend but is beaten by the away spin. De Kock collects the ball, appeals for a catch first and then takes the bails off before appealing again for a stumping. The square leg umpire signals upstairs but the replays find that Chandimal is safely in.
We have a stumping appeal here! Not a convincing appeal from de Kock though. Referred upstairs...
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and drives it to extra cover.
Flighted full ball on middle, it's pushed down off the front foot to mid on.
Bouncer around off, well-directed, de Silva ducks underneath it.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Darts in a full ball in the line of the stumps, Dhananjaya gets behind the line and blocks it back safely.
Good length ball on middle and leg, sliding down, de Silva tries flicking but misses.
Fullish delivery wide outside off, de Silva chases it looking to drive first up and gets beaten.
Dhananjaya de Silva walks in next.

OUT! Edged and gone! Rabada strikes! A loose shot from the Sri Lankan skipper and he is disappointed on his walk back to the pavilion. A full ball in the zone wide outside off, a needless poke inside the line by Mathews and he edges it behind to third slip. Elgar takes a nice low catch to end Mathews' stay of 115 minutes. Sri Lanka trail by 192 runs!
Fullish on off, driven off the front foot to mid off.
Loopy ball on middle, Chandimal gets on the front foot and pushes it to extra cover.
Flatter and on middle, turned through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! A tossed up ball around leg, a full toss, Chandimal clears his front leg and whips it through mid-wicket. Rabada moves across to his left from deep square leg but fails to pick up the ball near the fence. As a result, it touches the fence. A couple of gifts first up for Dinesh!
Spin for the first time. Keshav Maharaj to have a bowl. A slip and short leg in place...
Good length ball on middle, DC turns it in the gap at mid-wicket for one.
Fullish and on off, Dinesh pushes it from the crease to covers.
Back of a length ball on off, Chandimal goes on his toes and defends it to the off side.
Full again, on middle and leg, Chandimal plays it off his pads to the leg side.
Full and angling in around off, Chandimal gets behind the line and defends it back to the bowler.

Angelo Mathews appears to be struggling with his right elbow. The physio has been called yet again. Some more magic spray is being applied on the region as the Sri Lankan skipper gulps down a few painkillers.
Sharp delivery, angles in a full length ball on off, Mathews helps it in the gap at mid-wicket and picks up a single.
A leg stump yorker, Mathews brings his bat down just in time and pushes it towards fine leg for a single.
Angles in a full ball on off, Angelo gets across the stumps and defends it down safely.
On a length and around off, Chandimal taps it down to covers and calls his skipper quickly for a single.
Good length ball on off, holding its line, Chandimal shoulders arms.
Fullish and on off, DC draws forward and pushes it to mid off.
Spears in a full ball on middle, Chandimal pushes it towards mid on.
Bouncer! The batsman does well to evade it.
Rabada loses his line completely and sprays it way down the leg side. Angelo allows it through and once again agility of de Kock is put to test.
Fullish and on off, it's driven down the ground and the mid off fielder does well to make a tumbling stop.
Angles in a length ball on off, Angelo jumps on the back foot and plays it down to square leg.
Good length ball on off, Mathews pushes it off the outer half of the bat to point.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Good length ball outside off, holding its line, DC pushes at it and misses.
A good looking drive off the front foot to a full ball it has gone straight to the cover fielder.
Fuller and on off, Chandimal gets behind the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Sharp delivery, full and angling into the batsman, Chandimal tries to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. A stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire. Missing leg.
Fullish and moving in from around off, Mathews tries defending but it takes an inside edge and races behind square leg for a run.
Full length ball angling down the leg side, Mathews tries to flick but misses. De Kock dives full length to his left to stop the ball. Good take!
FOUR! Risky shot! Rabada bowls it full and wide outside off, Chandimal leans forward and unfurls a full-blooded square drive. It's uppish but flies just wide of diving Bavuma at backward point.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Straighter in line on this occasion, Mathews works it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
FOUR! Shortish ball on off, Mathews is quick to pick the length, goes on the back foot and slaps it through covers for a cracking boundary.
Fuller and outside off, it's driven square of the wicket on the off side and Bavuma gives the chase. Stops the ball in the deep and they take a couple.
Back of a length ball on off, Mathews defends it off his back foot.
Kagiso Rabada is back on.
Drinks break.
Too full in length on the pads, deflected down to fine leg for one.

Howzzat? A very full speared into the batsman, Chandimal digs it out off the inside edge and it goes through his legs to fine leg. They appeal as the batsmen cross. Nothing from the umpire. Hang on, the replays show that it brushed the front pad before taking the inner part of the bat. In that case, the impact is within line and it was hitting the stumps. But South Africa have no reviews left and hence Chandimal gets a life.
Length ball on middle, defended to the leg side.
FOUR! Good shot to get off the mark! Abbott darts in a fullish ball on off, Chandimal presents the full face of the bat as he gets forward and caresses it down the ground for a boundary.
Wide outside off, an easy leave on this occasion.
Probing line from Abbott as well. He puts it down on a fuller length just outside off, Chandimal has to play at it, he tries defending but the ball moves away to beat his bat.
Shortish and wide outside off, Mathews reaches out for it and pushes it to point.
On a length around off, Mathews defends it from within the crease.

Beaten comprehensively! This is outstanding bowling by Vernon. He angles in a full ball on off and opens up Mathews in his stance. The Lankan skipper tries defending but it swerves away to beat the outside edge.
Good length ball on off, Mathews goes back and taps it down to point.
Play and a miss! Philander slants in a full ball on off, Mathews tries pushing at it from the crease but it moves away to beat the outside edge. Angelo has a wry smile on his face.
On a length and around off, Mathews stays back and defends it to the off side.
Back of a length delivery on off, Chandimal sticks back and punches it to point.
Pitches it fuller and on off, Chandimal gets on the front foot and pushes it back to the bowler. Abbott picks it up in his followthrough and tosses it back past the striker to the keeper.
A little too straight on this occasion, Mathews quietly works it wide of mid on and crosses for a single.
An outswinger outside off, Angelo allows it through to the keeper.
Excellent delivery, full and on middle, shaping away a shade, Mathews tries to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It goes off the leading edge to gully.

FOUR! Shot! Fuller in length and outside off, Mathews reaches out for it and drives it with good timing through covers. Cook gives it the chase and dives near the fence to pull it back but all in vain.
Angles in a length ball on off, Chandimal defends it near his front pad.
Dinesh Chandimal is the new batsman.

OUT! Trapped in front! Philander hurls in a fuller length ball on off and gets it to curve back into the batsman, Silva draws forward to defend but misses and is hit on the pads. The bowler straightaway starts to run and celebrate before turning back to see the umpire. The finger is up. Silva opts for the review but to no use. The replays show that it's hitting middle. Sri Lanka trail by 225 runs!
Appeal for an lbw. Up goes the finger. Kaushal Silva takes the referral.
Straighter in line on this occasion, Mathews deflects it off his pads to fine leg for a run.
Look at that swing! Angling in and curling away viciously, around off, Angelo allows it through to the keeper.
Good length ball on off, straightening a bit, Mathews goes on the back foot and defends it to the off side.
Rash shot! Full length delivery in the zone outside off, nipping away, Mathews is lured into the drive and gets beaten. He is cross with himself for attempting that shot.
Full in length outside off, Silva drives it square of the wicket on the off side but straight to gully.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Full again, on off, Kaushal lunges and defends it to the off side.
Serves it fuller and on off, Mathews gets forward to defend but it takes the inside edge and runs down to fine leg for a single.
Fullish and shaping back into the batsman, Mathews draws forward in defense.
Bowls it on a driving length outside off, Mathews allows it through to the keeper.
Kyle Abbott (2/13) is back into the attack.

Edged but safe! Fuller in length on off, Silva commits himself on the front foot as he lunges to defend and does well to do so with soft bottom hand. The outside edge generated doesn't carry to the slip cordon as a result.
Turns it off his pads to backward square leg for a single. Given as a leg bye.
Darts in an inswinger this time, extra bounce as well, Mathews is surprised by it but does well to defend it safely on the off side.
Lands it full and just outside off, seaming away sharply, Mathews watches the line closely and judges the movement nicely before leaving it.
Another delivery outside off has been left alone by Angelo.
Chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Beaten! Better line this time by Kagiso, lands it on a fuller length outside off, shaping away a bit, Silva pushes inside the line and misses.
Offers width outside off, Silva is not tempted by the prospect of cracking it square of the wicket on the off side.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, it's left without played by Kaushal.
Hurls in an outswinger just outside off, Silva guards his stumps before shouldering his arms.
Full and on off, moving away, Silva feels for it and gets beaten.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, it's glanced off the hips through square leg for a couple of runs.
Good length delivery in the zone outside off, Mathews shoulders arms once again.
On a length and close to the off stump line, it straightens a touch, Mathews covers the line before shouldering arms.
Fullish on off, angling in, Mathews pushes it from the crease to covers.
EDGY FOUR! Philander serves it full and on off, shaping away, Mathews gets forward to drive it through the line but ends up edging it through the gap between gully and slips for a boundary.

Not out! Philander hurls in an inswinger, lands it full around off, Mathews draws forward to defend but misses and is hit on the back pad. They appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The bowler has a chat with his skipper and keeper. Faf du Plessis is convinced to take the referral but the replays show that the impact was outside off. South Africa have wasted both their reviews.
Appeal for an lbw. Not given. South Africa take the referral.
Bouncer on off, Kaushal ducks under it.
Fine shot. Picks a full ball off his pads and flicks it with good timing through mid-wicket. Maharaj gives the chase and slides near the fence to pull it back. A run is saved.
Full and angling in on middle, Mathews gently pushes it to square leg and looks for a run. Is sent back.
A shade short in length and around off, Mathews gets back inside the crease and turns it to square leg.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks in time to let that one go over him.
FOUR! Nice shot! Rabada bowls it on a fuller length around off, Mathews prefers staying back inside the crease and just pushes it through the middle of the bat. It runs away for a boundary at covers.
Bowls it closer to the off stump and takes it away with the seam movement, Silva strides forward to cover the line and shoulders arms.
Good length ball on off, shaping away, easily left by Kaushal.
FOUR! Nicely controlled shot! A fullish ball outside off, swinging away, Silva walks forward and leans into the drive. He connects superbly and sends it screaming through cover-point for a boundary.
No ball called overstepping. Fullish and on off, Silva presses forward in defense.
Beautifully bowled, an outswinger landing on middle, Silva is opened up a shade in his stance but does well to play it with soft hands. Keeps it out towards the slip cordon.
Wide outside off, Silva allows it through to the keeper.
Length ball around off, Mathews keeps it out off the inner half of the bat and it speeds down to long leg. A single taken.
Bouncer on leg, Silva sits underneath it with ease.
Full in length and on off, Silva gets on the front foot and pushes it to mid off.
Bowls it full and in the channel outside off, Silva has a comfortable leave on this occasion.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Slips a length ball down the leg side, Silva allows it through.
Short ball on off, Mathews gets across the stumps and fends it off behind square leg for a single. Wasn't in a good position to play that shot!
Kagiso Rabada to continue from the other end.
Lovely delivery once again. Philander bowls yet another outswinger around off, Silva has a watchful leave this time.
Good ball. A lovely outswinger angling into the right-hander, Silva plays for the line and gets beaten by the away movement.
Good length ball on off, Mathews gets back and pushes it with an angled bat past the gully fielder. A single taken.
Full in length and on off, shaping away, Mathews allows it through to the keeper.
Physio speeds out and using the magic spray.

Ouch! That's a nasty blow! A slightly short of a length ball around off, nipping back sharply, Mathews tries forcing it through the off side but fails. It goes on to hit him on the right elbow. Mathews throws his bat immediately in pain and clutches his elbow. You usually don't wear arm-guards on both hands.
Starts with a length ball on off, Mathews gets a bit squared up in defense and keeps it out off the outer half of the bat to point.
Welcome back, folks. The players are back on the field and the action is about to begin. Vernon Philander to begin proceedings...
...Day 2, Session 2...

It's a challenging wicket and Sri Lanka have their task cut out after the break. They will be hoping for an inspirational batting from their skipper to bail them out. Another exciting session awaits us. Do join us in a short while.

56/7 in the morning session and it was an action packed one! Sri Lanka wasted no time in picking South Africa's remaining four wickets but in response their top order was blown away. Vernon Philander and Kyle Abbott utilized the conditions to their advantage and put the Lankan batsmen to a stern test.
FOUR! A boundary to end the morning session. Very full in length by Rabada, outside off, Silva leans into the drive and squeezes it out through cover-point for a boundary. Lunch on day 2!
Bouncer down the leg side, Silva ducks underneath it.
Good length ball angling down the leg side, Silva tries flicking it down the leg side but misses.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Five wides! Rabada loses his radar completely, digs in a bouncer down the leg side. The batsman ducks and the keeper has no chance of stopping it. Bonus runs.
Fullish and angling into the batsman, Silva plays it with a loose bottom hand and pushes it towards gully. Bavuma dives full length to his left to stop the ball. Brilliant!
Lands it on a fuller length outside off, good probing line, Silva tries to defend off his front foot but misses.
Full in length and on off, holding its line, Mathews leaves it and de Kock collects it awkwardly. Seems to have hurt his fingers.
Slants in a fuller length ball on off, Silva brings his bat down in defense and gets it away off the inside half of the bat. It rolls to square leg and they cross for a single.
Hurls in an outswinger outside off, Silva has another leave.
Full ball just outside off, Silva prods forward to cover the line and then leaves it alone.
In the right channel, Silva lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

EDGY FOUR! Rabada serves yet another outswinger around off, Mathews is caught inside the crease as he attempts to play at it. Ends up edging it and luckily for him it goes through the gap between slips and gully for a boundary. Eventful first over by Kagiso!
Good length ball outside off, Mathews pokes inside the line but it moves away to beat the outside edge.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

NOT OUT! Nothing in the replays. Rabada dishes out an inswinger this time, around off, Mathews tries defending from the crease but misses. However, there is some sound and Rabada inquires about it politely. He seems convinced though and as a result Faf du Plessis opts for the review. The replays detect nothing.
Appeal for a catch! It's not given and Faf du Plessis takes the referral.
Good length delivery wide outside off, visible away movement again, Mathews shoulders arms.
Beautiful delivery first up, full and just outside off, nipping away, Mathews plays inside the line and gets beaten.
Kagiso Rabada replaces Philander in the attack.
Targets the off stump with a length ball, Mathews stays back and gently plays it down towards square  leg for one.
Good leave. Full in length and just outside off, holding its line, Mathews covers the line and then allows it through to the keeper.
Hurls in an outswinger this time but it's too wide outside off to trouble the batsman. An easy leave for Angelo!
Brilliant delivery, Abbott serves a full ball outside off and gets it to nip back in, Mathews covers the line before shouldering his arms.
On a good length and around off, Mathews makes a watchful leave.
Spears in a fuller length ball on middle, Mathews gets across the stumps and flicks it to mid-wicket. The fielder slides to stop the ball and keeps the batsmen at their respective ends.
Length delivery outside off, shaping away, Silva shoulders arms.
Outswinger way wide outside off, Silva has an easy leave.
Identical to the last delivery, Silva brings his bat down in front of his pads and defends it out safely.
Full and swinging in, around middle, Silva presses forward in defense.
Angles in a full ball again, on off, Silva defends it from the crease to the off side again.
Full and angling in, Silva gets on the front foot and defends it to the off side.
Skipper Angelo Mathews arrives.

OUT! Fine catch by Quinton de Kock! Abbott angles in a length ball on off and gets it to curve away off the seam, Mendis with minimum footwork goes for the drive and edges it behind. De Kock dives to his right to take a brilliant catch. Three down, Sri Lanka and in a spot of bother.
Inviting delivery, full and outside off, there to be driven, Mendis shoulders arms as it moves away and goes to the keeper.
Inswinger on this occasion, full and on middle, Mendis fails to flick and it goes off his pads to fine leg. A couple of leg byes taken.
Beauty of a delivery! Unplayable. Abbott angles in a length ball on off and it swerves away after kissing the deck, Mendis is squared up in defense and gets beaten. Lucky not to have edged it!
Drops it on a length and outside off, moving away, Mendis allows it through to the keeper.
A leg stump half volley, Silva moves across the stumps and nudges it to fine leg for a single.
Good length ball in the corridor of uncertainty, away movement visible there, Mendis shoulders arms.
Wrong line on this occasion, gets overambitious it appears and slips a full ball down the leg side. Mendis attempts to flick but misses.
On a length around off, straightening a bit, Mendis gets back and pushes it with an angled bat to backward point. Bavuma makes a half stop with a dive to his left and parries it to gully.
Arrows in a fuller length ball on off, Mendis gets on the front foot and defends it to the off side.
Kusal Mendis is in next.

OUT! Caught behind! That was always on the cards. Philander offers width outside off, Perera flashes his blade through the line and gets a fat outside edge to de Kock. He makes no mistake and Sri Lanka are two down. Very sloppy cricket. Strange tactics on a wicket assisting movement. In Perera's defense I can only say - that's how he knows to bat!
Back of a length delivery wide outside off, Perera throws his bat at it and misses. Hit out or get out seems to be the strategy from Perera!
Inswinger this time, outside off, Silva inside edges his forward defensive shot. Sri Lanka put to stern test here!
Full and angling in, shaping away after landing, Silva gets forward to defend and does so with the outer half of the bat. Rolls straight to second slip.
Edgy again! Lands it on a full length on off, Perera attempts to punch it through covers but gets an inside edge to fine leg. A single taken.

In the air... safe! Fullish and on middle, shaping back in after landing, Perera tries to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It pops out off the leading edge and goes safely to covers. They collect two runs and Silva had to dive to make it in.
Goes full with his length and bowls it on the middle stump line, Perera covers the line and defends it to mid off.
Play and a miss! Abbott tempts the batsman by offering room outside off, Perera flashes and misses. Abbott smiles and gives a stare to Kusal!
Angles in a full ball on middle, Kaushal pushes it back to the bowler. End of a testing over!
Full in length and outside off, shaping away, Silva allows it through to the keeper.
Fullish and on off, Silva strides forward to defend but gets an inside edge. It squirts through square leg and they take a brace.
Very full in length on middle and leg, Perera whips it through backward square leg and gets off strike.
Nearly drags it on. Philander serves an inswinger around off on a fuller length, Perera goes hard at it and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Too full in length on off, shaping back in a bit, Perera tries playing it through the line but gets an inside edge. It goes to square leg.
Good length ball on middle, Perera quietly drops it with soft hands to mid-wicket and pinches a single.
Beaten! Sharp delivery, angling a length ball away from the southpaw, Perera stays back and attempts to punch it through the line but is beaten.
Full in length and on off, Perera defends it to the off side.
On a length around middle and leg, Perera works it through square leg and gets off the mark with a couple of runs.
Kusal Perera is the number 3 batsman.

OUT! Drags it on! Abbott serves a fuller length ball outside off, shaping back in after hitting the deck, Karunaratne gets on the front foot and tries to play a drive away from his body. All he manages is a massive inside edge which takes the ball onto the stumps. Kyle draws first ball. On this pitch where the ball is moving a lot, this attempted shot should have been avoided.
Length ball outside off, Dimuth gets back and punches it through covers for a couple of runs.

Brings his variations into play. Philander hurls in an inswinger, lands it outside off, Silva leaves it alone for the keeper. Not sure if he picked it. Good take by de Kock. End of another probing over!
Big movement on this occasion but it's too wide outside off to trouble the batsman.

Excellent delivery, Silva has no answer to it. Length ball angling into the batsman and moving away a bit, Silva tries playing the line but gets beaten by the movement. It goes off his thigh pad to the slip cordon.
Much better this time by Silva. He watches the line closely and then judges the away movement. Lets it through after doing the basics right.
Play and a miss! Philander lands it on a fuller length outside off, Silva gets forward to defend but it moves away to beat the outside edge.
Philander throws it up very full and outside off, Silva drives it back past the bowler to mid off.
Once again a bit leg sidish, the ball moves back in a bit and hits Karunaratne on the pads as he fails to flick. It rolls behind and de Kock stops it quickly. Testing over!
Karunaratne is struggling here. Not a great line on this occasion, an outswinger bowled on the leg stump line, Karunaratne tries to flick but gets a leading edge. It rolls to point.
Beauty! Abbott bowls it on a fuller length around middle and off and gets it to swerve away off the seam, Karunaratne sticks back to play inside the line and misses.
Pitches it full and outside off, Karunaratne gets on the front foot and drives it towards mid off.
Abbott fails to control his line this time. Bowls an inswinger but the line is down the leg side. Karunaratne tries his best to flick but misses.

Edgy! Good length ball landing around middle and leg, Karunaratne tries to work it on the leg side but it nips away a shade to take the outside edge. The ball runs through the gap between point and gully for a couple of runs.
Kyle Abbott to steam in from the other end.
On a good length and outside off, shaping away a bit, Silva covers the line and shoulders arms.
Another nice delivery, full and angling in, it straightens a touch after landing, Silva pushes it with an angled bat to gully.
Fullish and angling in around off, Kaushal gets a bit forward and defends it to the off side.
Big, big movement, landing on a length around off and curling away sharply, Silva plays inside the line and misses.

FOUR! Risky but effective! A full swinging delivery outside off, Silva nicely leans into the cover drive and thumps it through the gap for a boundary. A brave shot to play against a moving ball with three slips waiting for a nick. Philander won't mind that shot at all.
Sri Lanka are away! On a length and around middle, moving back in again, Karunaratne works it off the inside half of the bat to fine leg for a single. It's called a no ball as well for overstepping.
Starts well, right on the money, it's full around off and seaming back in, Karunaratne gets behind the line and defends it back.
